About Us

The Team Behind KSV Solutions Ltd

KSV Solutions Ltd is Vish and his team, based in Solihull. We cover electrical work, CCTV, smart alarms, smart home technology, WiFi, networking and IT for homes and businesses across the West Midlands and Warwickshire, and travel further for bespoke jobs.

The work runs from a dome camera over a garage door to a full lighting fit-out for a restaurant, a data cabinet for an office or a smart panel that runs the whole house. Whatever the size, it is the KSV team that turns up, in the van with our number on the side.

We listen first, recommend the right system for the property and the budget, and show you how it all works before we leave. If you ever have a problem afterwards, you call the same team that fitted it.

VishOwner, KSV Solutions Ltd
